Subject: Follow-up & proposed technical deep-dive slots

Hi Alex —

Great to meet you and Priya on the discovery call today. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum:

- Goal: 45-minute technical deep-dive to validate architecture fit, data flows, and integration surface.
- Outcomes we expect: confirm routing model, data retention/segregation approach, and any network/firewall constraints.

Proposed slots (all 45 min):
1) Wed Jul 29, 10:00–10:45 PDT / 13:00–13:45 EDT
2) Thu Jul 30, 09:00–09:45 PDT / 12:00–12:45 EDT

Questions / asks:
- Which slot works best?
- Please confirm the list of attendees (engineering + security + any infra owners).
- Preference for Google Meet vs Zoom? We can send a Meet link if that’s easier.
- If your security team needs IPs or an allowlist, let us know and we’ll provide the service egress ranges.

I’ve attached a short demo deck we’ll reference and an initial requirements doc (draft). If you prefer, I can send a calendar invite once we lock the slot.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
